test_devices_add_camera_via_checkbox.title: DEVICES: Add camera to tile using checkbox selection

steps.action: On Views, open the Devices panel, expand the configured site and click All Cameras.
steps.expected: The site's camera thumbnails are listed.

steps.action: Hover the configured camera's thumbnail and tick its checkbox.
steps.expected: An empty tile fills with that camera's video.

test_devices_drag_camera_to_tile.title: DEVICES: Drag camera thumbnail directly to empty tile.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Views > Empty Grid State
steps.expected: Empty Grid State page loads without errors

steps.action: Wait for data to finish loading (spinners, skeleton loaders disappear)
steps.expected: All data sections have loaded completely

steps.action: Locate empty grid tile displays Drag & Drop Camera here text on the page
steps.expected: empty grid tile displays Drag & Drop Camera here text is visible in the expected location

steps.action: Verify the data values are populated and not empty or showing placeholders
steps.expected: Actual data values are displayed (not 'N/A', 'Loading...', or '---')

steps.action: Verify the data format is correct (numbers, dates, labels, etc.)
steps.expected: Data is formatted according to the expected display format

steps.action: Verify empty grid tile displays Drag & Drop Camera here text is displayed as expected
steps.expected: empty grid tile displays Drag & Drop Camera here text is displayed as expected

steps.action: Refresh the page and verify the data displays consistently
steps.expected: Same data appears after page refresh

test_my_views_add_saved_view_via_checkbo.title: MY VIEWS: Add saved view to tile using checkbox.

steps.action: Create a new tab, add a camera, rename with unique name, and save the view
steps.expected: View is saved successfully

steps.action: Reload page and click the My Views tab
steps.expected: My Views panel opens with saved view listed

steps.action: Hover on the saved view to reveal checkbox, then click it
steps.expected: Saved view is added

steps.action: Verify a new tab with the view name was opened
steps.expected: Tab with the view name exists

test_my_views_drag_saved_view_to_tile.title: MY VIEWS: Drag saved view directly to tile

steps.action: On Views, click the plus tab, rename the new tab, add the first camera with its checkbox, and click Save.
steps.expected: A toast reads View saved successfully.

steps.action: Reload the page and click the My Views subtab.
steps.expected: The saved view is listed by its name.

steps.action: Drag the saved view onto an empty tile.
steps.expected: The tile fills with the view content, or the view opens as a new tab.
